name: one-dimensional random field
domain: 车辆轨道结构与数值方法
definition_zh: 沿一个空间坐标描述参数随机变化的场。
usage_note: 所引模型将扣件物理参数视为沿线路纵向的一维随机场，轨道板和底座的物理、几何参数视为确定值。

complete_examples.text: The scheme of mapping a multi-dimensional random field to a one-dimensional random field is utilized to present the multi- dimensional covariance function as a two-dimensional covariance matrix.

In this section, two special cases are performed: (1) Case 1: the variability of fastener parameter (one-dimensional random field); (2) Case 2: the spatial randomness of the filling layer (two- dimensional field).
